one_line: Global AI infrastructure expansion drives massive corporate spending, workforce shifts, and market and policy resistance.

themes.title: Data center expansion faces policy and market headwinds
themes.text: Asian markets fell amid fears that US Democrats might delay data centers, while protests and policy shifts target data center growth. OpenAI promised to pay full electricity costs and drop official NDAs, and a coalition of tech firms and environmental groups began negotiating a national data center framework.

stories.headline: Asian tech stocks plunge amid fears US Democrats may delay data centers
OpenAI steps back from NDAs and promises full power costs for data centers
Big tech and environmental groups negotiate national data center framework
Activists breach Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam as protests spread across Europe

themes.title: Infrastructure spending and corporate restructuring accelera
themes.text: Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to roughly 27% of its global workforce as AI spending increases, and Dropbox announced a $350 million acquisition of Tigris Data for AI workloads. Meanwhile, Nvidia detailed hardware advances aimed at boosting memory efficiency and agentic throughput.

stories.headline: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI spending grows
Dropbox to acquire AI storage startup Tigris Data for $350 million
Nvidia uses full‑stack codesign to boost AI memory efficiency
Nvidia vera cpu offers higher agent throughput and better power efficiency

themes.title: New models and enterprise agents launch
themes.text: Airbnb announced plans for a custom-interface AI travel agent in 2027, and Mistral updated its Studio platform to support enterprise deployment of the Le Chonk multimodal model. Google DeepMind launched the Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generative video model, and Nvidia released four open-weight Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for simulation.

stories.headline: Airbnb announces plans to launch an AI travel agent in 2027
Mistral launches Studio Le Chonk platform for enterprise AI deployment
Google DeepMind launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model with 15-second clips
Nvidia adds four open-weight Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for interactive simulation
